headline: Maguire In The Dock For test3
deck: test3's Maguire caught up in the Man City verdict fallout; no draft consequence stated.
body:
The wire has Kieran Maguire, owned by test3, fielding listener questions on the Man City verdict alongside Dale Johnson. That is the sum of it: a name test3 holds, attached to the story the whole league already knows.

Nothing in the copy touches minutes, fitness or return. test3 reads it as we do and takes nothing from it beyond the reminder that the asset is his.
